NEW packages/core/src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-evidence-safe-value.ts — 236 physical lines (<=250). Non-barrel internal module, two exported functions plus a result/issue union (PROXY|ACCESSOR|HOSTILE_SHAPE|CYCLE|DEPTH_LIMIT|WORK_LIMIT|STRING_LIMIT|BODY_LIMIT), all refusals Object.freeze'd. Order of operations is load-bearing and commented: node:util/types isProxy FIRST (Array.isArray and Object.getPrototypeOf both throw on a revoked proxy), then prototype identity (Object.prototype/null for records, Array.prototype for arrays), then Reflect.ownKeys + Reflect.getOwnPropertyDescriptor — a descriptor without a `value` slot is ACCESSOR and is never read; symbol keys, non-enumerables and functions are HOSTILE_SHAPE. Arrays require ownKeys.length === length + 1 and a present enumerable data descriptor at every 0..length-1 slot, which rejects sparse holes and extra own keys in one measurement. Traversal is an explicit Frame stack (no recursion) with an on-path Set for CYCLE. Bounds: DEPTH_LIMIT at MAX_JSON_DEPTH (64) checked before push; WORK_LIMIT at MAX_SAFE_VALUE_NODES = MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES >> 1 = 524288 (every node costs >=2 canonical bytes, so this is derived, not invented); STRING_LIMIT via Buffer.byteLength on scalars AND keys before the copy grows. Only primitives are copied into the detached graph. Catch-all fence converts any residual reflective throw to HOSTILE_SHAPE. canonicalizeLiveQuiesceSafeValue is an iterative emission stack that accumulates UTF-8 bytes and returns BODY_LIMIT BEFORE pieces.join("") — an over-budget value never materialises as one oversized string.

FINDING FOUND AND FIXED MID-DRILL. First pass of M5b came back GREEN (exit 0, Tests 13 passed). Cause: with `new Array(1)` the own-key COUNT fence fires first with the same HOSTILE_SHAPE tag, so the per-slot presence check was a redundant guard hidden by an identical downstream fence — and even when the hole survives, reading it yields `undefined`, which the scalar fence also refuses with HOSTILE_SHAPE. Fixed by DIVERGENCE, not by deleting the redundant call: (a) array density/extra-key refusals now emit a distinct ARRAY_SHAPE tag so a hole reaching the scalar fence (HOSTILE_SHAPE) is distinguishable; (b) added a divergence fixture the count fence CANNOT see — `[item]` with `length = 2` plus one enumerable padding key, asserted in-test to satisfy `Reflect.ownKeys().length === length + 1` while `getOwnPropertyDescriptor(a,"1")` is undefined. M5b then redded. Also added a CYCLE case (self-referencing citationKey) so the cycle guard is no longer unexercised; M9 confirms it diverges from the depth fence. Roster grew 11 -> 13 and the issue-set is asserted as an exact set: {CYCLE,DEPTH_LIMIT,ACCESSOR,PROXY,HOSTILE_SHAPE,ARRAY_SHAPE,STRING_LIMIT,BODY_LIMIT}.

ADVERSARIAL INSPECTION. Allocation: `new Array(length)` happens AFTER the ownKeys count check, so `new Array(1e9)` is refused (ownKeys=["length"]) before any allocation; node count is capped at 524288; canonical `pieces` are byte-capped before each push, so neither the snapshot nor the emitter can grow unbounded. Prototype pollution: detached records are `Object.create(null)`, so an own `__proto__` data key is copied as an inert key and then rejected by the unchanged exact-key schema. Canonical order: keys sorted at emit time, verified by the golden and the both-insertion-orders arm. TOCTOU: the graph is detached before any schema read, and the caller-mutation arm is bidirectional. Byte accounting: BODY_LIMIT measures the ESCAPED emitted piece, so lone surrogates cannot undercount. NOT DRILLED / disclosed: WORK_LIMIT (needs >524288 nodes; too costly for a unit arm) — the bound is present and reachable but unexercised by the roster.
